tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gtor ma brgya rtsa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yab// khams gsum sems can bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma// srid gsum yid kyi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla sogs mkha' sogs dge sbyong sogs// lhan sogs gzhi sogs 'brog gnas sogs// bgegs sogs rigs drug yi dwags sogs// gnod byed ma thob rnams la sbyin// las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o// de la'ang gtor zan gtsang ma la/ dkar gsum dang*/ mngar gsum la sogs pa yod na sbag chu gtsang ma dang*/ gtor snod bcu'am lnga/ bum pa sogs snod dang bcas pa sta gon byas la/ zan gsum tshan gsum dang*/ gnyis tshan gcig gis brgya rtsa brgyad du bya ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po phul la/ 'phags pa rnams mnyes shing rigs drug rnams chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ dang po zan bcu chus sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhām̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam zhing*/ bcu tshan dang po/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig gis rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yid dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor bas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/

rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po che po sde bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs pa/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che skyong ba/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas rgya gar dang*/ bod kyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ gdan sa khyad par can rnams skyong zhing*/ bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag chos sgrub pa 'khor bcas kyi/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa dang*/ rkyen phyi dang nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ tshig tsam gyis phan 'dogs nus pa/ smon lam gyi sa la dbang ba/ dmod pa 'dor nus pa rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor bcas kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen chos bzhin 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab tu gsol/ bzhi pa yan chod la sngags nyer gcig re dang*/ man chod la bdun bdun brjod do// bzhi pa bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ rnam thos sras dang*/ dzambha la dang*/ nor rgyun ma dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/

bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung skyob mdzad pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// nad dang*/ dbul ba dang*/ phongs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lnga pa/ rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par du bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu yul phyogs dang*/ sa cha 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul lo// 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phebs pa dang*/ lo phyogs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ mu ge dang*/ 'khrug pa zhi zhing mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ drug pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po la sogs pa 'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs pa phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'brog gnas mched kyi tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// sems can gyi srog dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi zhing*/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi nas/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag yams kyi bdag mo/ gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs/ sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams la sbyin no// deng phyin chad bsam ngan dang gdug rtsub dang gnod 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar gyur cig

bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la'ang gnod pa'i bsam pa bsal nas phan sems dang ldan par gyur cig brgyad pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig dgu pa/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs pa phyi'i sgrib pa can dang nang gi sgrib pa can dang me lce'i 'khor lo can dang*/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can dang mkha' la rgyu ba dang klungs na gnas pa dang byings na gnas pa dang kha 'thor gyi tshogs bkres skom dang dbul phongs kyis bsdus pa mtha' dag la sbyin no// so so'i mdun du zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po phab nas/ lus dang sems la phan pa dang*/ bde bar longs spyod cing tshim par gyur cig ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing*/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bcu pa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags kyi mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang*/ tshe 'dir yang thugs zur dang spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no// lan chags thams cad byang*/ bu lon thams cad khyer ba dang*/ phrag dog tu gyur pa dang*/ gnod byed kyi tshogs rnams gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing re ba thams cad skong bar gyur cig bcu gcig pa/ ma thob pa/ ma sleb pa/ kha zhan cing dbang chung ba/ gtor ma la re ba/ glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams dang*/ skal ba chad pa/ kha zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// so sor zas skom gyis tshim nas/

myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces brjod do// bdun pa man chad la sngags bdun bdun brjod pa'i rjes la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod par bya'o// mjug tu kha zas ma thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin mdzad par bsgoms la/ chu dang snod zas kyis ma gos par byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du bzhag la/ phyag g.yas nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis kha 'bar ma dang 'jur 'gegs can la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ dzwa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes pas bsngos la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces pas chu sbyin bya'o// 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams la thun mong du ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// zhes pa dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas 'dod pa'i don thams cad bsgo bar bya'o// se gol brdabs nas/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ zhes pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su song bar bsam/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs kyi mchog gtor ma yin no// khyad par du yang tshe 'di nas bzung nas skye ba nas skye bar longs spyod chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/

nor sgrub kyi mchog sbyin pa yin zhing gtor ma la sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi tshang ba'i phyir ro// las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i gnas su bris pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
